messages.content: I’ll commit a two-cycle DA plan: charge overnight and late morning, then discharge during the morning rise and the HE20–21 peak. I’ll start with the same physical schedule and reassess at each watch as RT prices and notices arrive.

At 18:00 CPT, the battery is full at 180 MWh, with 32 discharge units left. No new notices or derates have appeared. I’ll retain the 19:00–21:00 discharge schedule; those remain the highest-priced DA hours.
